notes: apkReady/apkUrl is the future production-signed release (see MOBILE_BUILD.md) — flip apkReady once app/tiga-ai.apk exists. betaApkReady/betaApkUrl is today's CI-built debug APK, served same-origin from app/tiga-ai-beta.apk so it doesn't depend on GitHub's release CDN. Debug and production builds use different signing keys, so a device that installs the beta build will need one uninstall+reinstall the day the signed production build replaces it — expected, not a bug.
